## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New samplers have a goodness-of-fit test and parameter validation tests
- [ ] JSDoc updated (with an `@example` for new public functions)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Numbers and claims were measured or checked against an independent source
- [ ] If AI wrote a substantial part: I understand it, I checked it, and I say how above
